title: List sessions
summary: List active and recent sessions with agent, environment, status, usage, and timestamps. Archived sessions are excluded unless include_archived=true is passed.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Optional. Page size, default 20, capped at 1000.

parameters.name: page
parameters.description: Optional. Cursor returned as next_page or prev_page by a previous response. It binds the order and created_at window it was issued under; other filters may change across a replay.

parameters.name: order
parameters.description: Optional. asc or desc by created_at; default desc (newest first). Any other value is a 400.

parameters.name: agent_id
parameters.description: Optional. Only sessions created with this agent.

parameters.name: agent_version
parameters.description: Optional. Pinned-version filter; applies only when agent_id is set and is ignored otherwise. A non-integer value is a 400.

parameters.name: include_archived
parameters.description: Optional. Pass true to include archived sessions. Omitting it, or passing false, excludes them. Any other value is a 400.

parameters.name: statuses
parameters.description: Optional. Repeatable filter on the published status values: idle, running, rescheduling, terminated. The SDK's statuses[] spelling is accepted too; each value selects every internal state in that public group. Any other value is a 400.

parameters.name: memory_store_id
parameters.description: Optional. Only sessions holding a memory_store resource with this id.

parameters.name: deployment_id
parameters.description: Optional. Only sessions created by this scheduled deployment.

parameters.name: created_at[gt] | created_at[gte] | created_at[lt] | created_at[lte]
parameters.description: Optional. Creation-time bounds. An unparseable timestamp is a 400.

response.name: data
response.description: Session envelopes visible to the current workspace.

title: Create session
summary: Create an executable agent session in an environment. Sessions persist a resumable event log and can be continued through messages or raw events.

parameters.name: agent
parameters.description: Agent id, an object with an id and optional version, or an agent_with_overrides object that replaces selected fields (model, system, tools, mcp_servers, skills) for this session only.

parameters.name: environment_id
parameters.description: Environment template used to prepare the session runtime.

parameters.name: title
parameters.description: Optional human-readable session title.

parameters.name: resources
parameters.description: Files, GitHub repositories, or memory stores mounted into the session. A file or github_repository on an environment whose sandbox_provider cannot serve the canonical mount roots (docker, kubernetes, self_hosted) is refused with resource_not_mountable before the session is created.

parameters.name: vault_ids
parameters.description: Credential vault ids available to tools during this session.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Opaque key-value tags for audit and external bookkeeping.

response.name: id
response.description: Server-generated sess_... identifier.

response.name: status
response.description: Current session lifecycle state.

response.name: agent
response.description: Materialized agent snapshot: pinned version, and multiagent always null — a declared roster is refused by name.

response.name: budget
response.description: Spending ceiling. Always present; null when the session has none, whether never set or removed.

response.name: stats
response.description: active_seconds (cumulative running time from the event log) and duration_seconds (since creation, frozen at the last update once terminal or archived).

response.name: outcome_evaluations
response.description: One entry per user.define_outcome, in declaration order: outcome_id, description, result (pending | running | evaluating while in progress, then the terminal end-span verdict), iteration, explanation, completed_at.

response.name: usage
response.description: Input and output token counters recorded by the runtime.

response.name: created_at
response.description: RFC 3339 creation timestamp.

title: Get session
summary: Fetch one session envelope including current status, resources, usage, and pinned agent/environment metadata.

response.name: id
response.description: Session identifier.

response.name: session
response.description: Created or updated session resource.

title: Update session
summary: Patch a session in place: agent admits only tools/mcp_servers (full replacement, materialized as the session's own snapshot), metadata merges per key with null removing a key, title replaces with null clearing, and budget moves the ceiling under the budget rules (budget_create_only, budget_not_raised, model_not_budgetable) in any non-terminal state — a raise or removal also resumes a session parked on stop_reason budget_reached without a new message. An agent change needs an idle session; vault_ids is a named refusal. One session.updated event reports the fields that changed.

response.name: session
response.description: Updated session resource. A request that changed nothing still returns the session, with no session.updated event appended.

title: List session events
summary: Read the durable event log for a session. Use after non-streaming runs or to reconstruct a timeline.

response.name: data
response.description: Events ordered by creation sequence.

title: Append raw event
summary: Append one or more user.* events to a session log. This is lower-level than the message convenience endpoint. A user.steer event is delivered to the turn already running and answered with a receipt.

parameters.name: events
parameters.description: Array of user.* events. Each event must be an object with a non-empty string type. A user.steer carries input_id (idempotency key), text, and an optional expected_turn_id.

response.name: accepted
response.description: True when the event batch was accepted. False for a user.steer whose receipt state is rejected or conflict.

response.name: steer
response.description: Present for a user.steer: input_id, state (delivered | duplicate | conflict | rejected | outcome_unknown), and turn_id or detail when available. outcome_unknown must never be replayed.

title: Send message
summary: Append a user message and run the agent loop. Set stream to true for Server-Sent Events compatible with browser clients and SDK iterators.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: User message text or structured content blocks.

parameters.name: stream
parameters.description: When true, returns an SSE stream of session and agent events.

parameters.name: metadata
parameters.description: Optional event-level metadata.

response.name: event
response.description: Streaming event when stream is true.

response.name: accepted
response.description: True when stream is false and the message was accepted.

title: Stream session events
summary: Subscribe to a session's Server-Sent Events. With a Last-Event-ID cursor the stored events after it are replayed and the stream then goes live; without one it carries live events only, and a cursor that is not the numeric seq is refused with a 400 before the stream opens.

parameters.name: Last-Event-ID
parameters.description: The seq of the last event you saw. Omit it for a live-only stream; send 0 to replay the whole log.

response.name: event
response.description: Live session and agent-loop events.

response.name: ping
response.description: event: ping with data {"type":"ping"} and no id, so it cannot move the resume cursor.

title: List session artifacts
summary: List artifact file resources produced or attached during a session.

response.name: data
response.description: Artifact resources scoped to the session.

title: Create session artifact
summary: Persist an artifact under /artifacts/ for a session and return its file resource envelope.

parameters.name: path
parameters.description: Artifact path. Must start with /artifacts/.

parameters.name: content
parameters.description: Artifact content encoded as UTF-8 or base64.

parameters.name: encoding
parameters.description: Content encoding. Defaults to utf8.

response.name: id
response.description: Server-generated file_... identifier.

response.name: artifact_path
response.description: Normalized artifact path.

title: Download session artifact
summary: Download the bytes for one session artifact.

response.name: body
response.description: Artifact content stream.

title: Interrupt session (deprecated alias)
summary: Deprecated local user.interrupt alias, removed next version. Interrupt the active turn, retain its sandbox, and return the full session envelope. Idle is a no-op; an already terminal session returns 409. Unconfirmed Pi cleanup remains terminated.

response.name: id
response.description: Session identifier retained for another message.

response.name: status
response.description: Full session envelope; successful interruption leaves idle with end_turn, not terminated.

title: Archive session
summary: Archive an idle session, release its sandbox, and return the session envelope. Running sessions return session_running until interrupted; repeating the archive is idempotent.

response.name: status
response.description: Archived sessions report terminated.

response.name: archived_at
response.description: ISO 8601 archive timestamp.

title: Delete session
summary: Permanently delete a session and its session-owned state. Running sessions must be interrupted first.

response.name: id
response.description: The deleted session id.

response.name: type
response.description: Official deletion envelope discriminator.

title: List session resources
summary: List the resource instances attached to a session. Each instance carries its own sesrsc_ id, so it can be addressed without rewriting the session payload.

response.name: data
response.description: Attached resources ordered by position. A github_repository credential never includes its authorization_token.

title: Add a session resource
summary: Attach a file or github_repository resource to a running session. A memory_store can only be attached when the session is created, because memories are part of the context the session was built with. A backend that cannot serve the canonical mount roots (docker, kubernetes, self_hosted) refuses this with resource_not_mountable and records nothing.

parameters.name: type
parameters.description: file or github_repository. memory_store is refused here with invalid_request.

parameters.name: file_id
parameters.description: Required for a file resource.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: Required for a github_repository resource. Must be https://github.com/<owner>/<repo>.

parameters.name: authorization_token
parameters.description: Required for a github_repository resource. Write-only: it is never echoed in any response.

parameters.name: mount_path
parameters.description: Optional sandbox mount path. Defaults to /workspace/<repo-name>.

parameters.name: checkout
parameters.description: Optional {type:branch,name} or {type:commit,sha}. Omit it to clone the repository's default branch.

response.name: id
response.description: The new resource instance id, e.g. sesrsc_ab12cd34ef56gh78.

title: Get a session resource
summary: Read one resource instance by its own sesrsc_ id.

response.name: data
response.description: The resource instance. Write-only credential material is absent, not masked.

title: Rotate a github authorization token
summary: Replace the authorization_token of a github_repository resource on a running session (published verb). Only that field is updatable; changing the repository, checkout, or mount path requires a new session.

parameters.name: authorization_token
parameters.description: The replacement token. Any other field is refused with invalid_request rather than ignored.

response.name: data
response.description: The updated instance. The token is never echoed.

title: Rotate a github authorization token (deprecated alias)
summary: Deprecated alias of the POST update above, kept for existing callers. Same handler, same refusal rules.

parameters.name: authorization_token
parameters.description: The replacement token. Any other field is refused with invalid_request rather than ignored.

response.name: data
response.description: The updated instance. The token is never echoed.

title: Remove a session resource
summary: Detach a file or github_repository resource from a session. A memory_store resource cannot be removed. Answers the published tombstone, not the detached object.

response.name: id
response.description: The removed resource instance id.

response.name: type
response.description: Literal session_resource_deleted.
